description: Search the Research Exposure Ledger's awards. Filter by list (BIOSECURE, 1260H, UFLPA, SEC889, FCC_COVERED), vendor id (bgi, mgi, novogene, wuxi_apptec, dji, autel, hikvision, dahua, huawei, unitree, tp_link...), agency, attribution tier (likely_paid, narrow, broad), institution, or free text (award number, recipient, project title). Returns totals for the filter and up to 25 awards, largest FY2025 obligation first, with vendors, lists, rule status and project end date. Free.
name: exposure_awards
title: Search exposed federal awards
